name: hud_sensor_tracker_reset_mission_state
description: HudSensorTracker::ResetMissionState clears mission identity/state fields, empties mission path strings, removes and deletes the weather FX pass-3 object, and returns success. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The Binary Ninja SetVisible and deleting-destructor slot calls are ABI evidence for the broader HUD/weather owner model, not justification for production source VTable/FTable or raw slot scaffolds.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4176f0 clears missionLoaded and missionId, calls CString::Empty for missionDataPath and zbdPath, clears worldNode, sets missionFlags to 1, clears objectiveCount, then for a non-null fxPass3Obj calls the HudUiElement SetVisible virtual slot with zero, removes the object from g_zVideoFxPass3ConfigLocal, calls the HudUiElement destructor virtual slot with delete flag 1, clears fxPass3Obj, and returns 1.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4176f0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same field resets, CString providers, HudUiContainer::RemoveChild call, HudUiElement dispatch evidence, weather FX deletion evidence, and success return.

Current production source no longer carries HudSensorTracker-local raw slot helpers; it calls the typed HudUiElement visibility method and tears down the recovered HudWeatherFx owner produced by LoadMissionWeatherFx.

The native hud_sensor_reset_mission_state_smoke verifies mission field resets, path empties, pass-3 weather object removal, fxPass3Obj clear, and return value 1 without fabricating a Hud VTable/FTable.
